reasoning: This is a standard AUR -bin package with no injection risks. The PKGBUILD has no top-level execution, no .install hooks exist, and the package() function only installs the verified binary to /usr/bin/omp and generates shell completions by running the binary in an isolated temporary environment (mocked HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME) — a defensive practice. learnings: Tool errors (API failures, JSON decode errors) on trivial non-executable files (.gitignore, .editorconfig) should not force an inconclusive verdict when security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO) are successfully analyzed and found safe

The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to missing analysis of critical files' vs 'inconclusive due to transient API errors on trivial files' and override to safe when the latter occurs

For -bin packages, models correctly focus on: source URL provenance, checksum pinning (not SKIP), and build-time execution. This pattern recognition is working well and should be reinforced in prompts
